name: llama-aio-workspace
description: Llama AIO monorepo: shared core, VS Code extension, and terminal UI.

scripts.compile: npm run compile -w @llama-aio/core && npm run bundle -w llama-aio-vs && npm run compile -w @llama-aio/tui
scripts.package: npm run compile && npm test && npm run package:vsix && npm run package:tui
